request: Project managers should be able to see the full history of engagement with a country before starting a new mission.
pre_mortem: A year after launch, a project manager used the engagement history feature to prepare for a sensitive meeting, relying on outdated records. Unbeknownst to the manager, certain diplomatic communications had changed drastically due to new developments that were not reflected in the system. This resulted in diplomatic faux pas, causing misunderstandings and damaging relationships with the country in question. The incident led to a breach of trust, heavy criticism, and triggered an inquiry into data management practices within the CRM.
gaps: What happens to engagement records when project managers change roles or leave the organization?
How will the system ensure that diplomatic and confidential records are not accessible to unauthorized users?
What is the retention policy for engagement records, especially sensitive ones?
Are there specific thresholds in terms of the number of engagements or records retained that determine which records are displayed?
Who defines what constitutes "sensitive" engagement records and what are the criteria for this definition?
What protocols define and enforce the security clearance necessary for accessing engagement records?

proposals.summary: This release will enable project managers to access a complete history of engagement with each country before initiating new missions. The feature will include timestamped records of past engagements, notes, and outcomes for all related contacts within the CRM.

core_commitments.text: Project managers can view a detailed engagement history for each country.
The engagement history includes timestamps, record notes, and outcomes.

in_scope.text: Project managers will have access to a dedicated 'Engagement History' section in the CRM.
Engagement history means all recorded interactions with government counterparts, including meetings, communications, and notes.
The system will display engagement history for all countries with which there is a past record in the CRM.
Users can filter the engagement history by date range and type of interaction.
Project managers must have appropriate security clearance to access sensitive engagement records.
